title: French-Style Tamagoyaki with Crunchy Apple
description: A modern twist on traditional French cuisine, combining Japanese tamagoyaki with crunchy apple and a hint of French flair.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of butter and let it melt.
Add 2 slices of apple and cook for 2 minutes on each side, until caramelized.
Add 2 pieces of tamagoyaki to the pan and cook for 1 minute on each side.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter, granulated sugar, and cinnamon to the pan.
Cook for an additional 30 seconds, until the sugar has dissolved.
Serve the tamagoyaki with the crunchy apple and drizzle with the caramel sauce.
Repeat the process for the remaining ingredients.
